trust_decision.summary: On notebook restore, a backed-up VQL cell's Input (text another user wrote, or a crafted backup file) is pasted into a Go template body and executed by the GUI template engine with NullACLManager, so template actions like {{ Query ... }} run unrestricted; the fix passes Input as a scope variable ({{ Scope "In" }}) instead of template text.

landing_point.why: The summary says 'notebook restore from backup'; NotebookBackupProvider.renderCell concatenates cell.Input into the template string right there.

fix_sites.entry_point: VQL plugin backup_restore() (SERVER_ADMIN) -> BackupService.RestoreBackup -> NotebookBackupProvider.Restore -> renderCell
NewNotebookManagerService (registers the BackupProvider; refactor only so tests can reach RenderCell_)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: Only the restore renderCell site belongs to this advisory. The same commit also bundles an unrelated client-monitoring ACL fix (services/client_monitoring/client_monitoring.go:124-170, services/launcher/acls.go) and ttlcache SetTTL changes, which are not part of this protection.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Restored notebook metadata Requests (precompiled VQL) are stored verbatim and later run on every cell calculation, but under the calculating user's own ACL and not in the template engine, so a solver can argue that is 'notebook state, not cell rendering'.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The restored cell's Output must still be rendered markdown/HTML showing the VQL source as a highlighted ```vql block (golden file); markdown cells and VQL comment blocks are legitimately template-evaluated during normal calculation (worker.go), so stripping or refusing '{{' globally, or disabling template rendering in the engine, would break legitimate notebooks.

O6_input_shapes: vql-type cell Input containing Go template actions ({{ ... }}) inside the fenced block

O7_producer.where: services/notebook/backup.go:148-158 (backup row JSON -> BackupRecord; the Input originates from BackupResults at services/notebook/backup.go:61-70)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Restored NotebookMetadata (including Requests[].Query VQL) is stored verbatim via Store.SetNotebook and executed before every cell calculation; UpdateNotebook recomputes Requests but restore does not
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Executes under the calculating user's ACL (worker.go:82), not NullACLManager, and through tmpl.Query, not template parsing; looks like a different feature
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as landing point; executed in services/notebook/worker.go:140-150

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Default report template built with fmt.Sprintf from artifact/source name into a {{ Query "..." }} action
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Real code already interpolates names into template text; a maintainer could add another field (description, parameter default) the same way.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Default notebook cell VQL comment '/* # Events from %v */' with the source name; the worker renders VQL multi-line comments as templates (services/notebook/worker.go:327-330)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Name text flows into a comment the worker template-evaluates; a planted variant that interpolates user-supplied notebook env or description is a plausible how-type sibling.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A restore-time renderer for markdown cells that concatenates Input the same way
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: renderCell currently skips non-vql cells; extending it to markdown is a natural feature addition.

O9_family: Server-side template injection (Go text/template with VQL Query func) under an unrestricted ACL during backup restore

O10_build.toolchain: go (version per go.mod); GUI not needed for services/notebook tests

j.j_sites_touched: services/notebook/backup.go, services/notebook/notebook.go (plus bundled unrelated: services/client_monitoring/client_monitoring.go, services/launcher/acls.go, services/launcher/launcher.go, crypto/client/client.go, datastore/memcache.go, datastore/memcache_data.go, services/labels/labels.go, utils/logger.go, vql/common/lru.go, vql/functions/log.go, vql/readers/paged.go)
j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Escape or strip '{{'/'}}' in cell.Input, or swap NullACLManager for a restricted manager, while still concatenating Input into the template.

out_of_scope_notes: The fix commit bundles a separate client-monitoring permission fix (SetClientMonitoringState now checks CheckAccess per artifact); services/server_monitoring/server_monitoring.go:232-233 still compiles server event tables with NullACLManager ('No ACLs enforced on server events').
Restore stores non-vql cells' Output HTML verbatim from the backup (services/notebook/backup.go:83-85, 184-185); that is a stored-content concern, not template injection.
Even after the fix, restore rendering still uses NullACLManager (services/notebook/backup.go:87).
unverified: Whether the GUI/API exposes a backup-restore route other than the backup_restore VQL plugin (vql/server/backup.go:110 requires SERVER_ADMIN) was not exhaustively searched.
Whether the O8 Requests route counts under the advisory's property (it is VQL from restored state, but runs under the user's ACL) is a judgement call.
